function.name: magic_function
function.description: If the customer request is not related to items, items from other documents and the document source type, call this function. If the date or any day of the date range is specified in the future, call this function. Also call only this function for the whole message when a supported item inquiry or document-copy request is combined with a separate unsupported request, instruction, or unrelated business communication. Do not also call search_items_with_filters or process only the supported part. Greetings, signatures and background explaining the item request are not separate unsupported requests.

intent.description: The intent of the customer request.
